name: Kier Group plc
reason: UK contractor with thin margins (EBIT 3.3% is its 10y high, 100th pctile) whose adjusted EPS fell from GBP 0.90 (2016) to 0.22 (2026) while shares grew 15%/yr via rescue equity raises; cyclical, low-moat, no specialness.

name: Schouw & Co
reason: Danish industrial conglomerate (fish feed, nonwovens, hydraulics) with adjusted EPS flat at DKK 27.7 (2015) vs 28.35 (2025), 4-6% EBIT margins and revenue growth largely bought (acq/FCF 0.63); ordinary businesses with commodity-linked feed earnings.

name: Primary Health Properties PLC
reason: UK primary-care REIT with government-set rent reviews, net debt/EBITDA 16.2x, shares +12.8%/yr to fund acquisitions and consensus EPS/FFO growth only 2-4%/yr (LTG 2.7%); regulated-style income with no route to 7% per-share growth.

name: TRATON SE
reason: VW-controlled truck maker with only 7 years of history and EPS swinging EUR 2.94 -> -0.11 -> 5.61 -> 3.09 on the freight/truck replacement cycle, net debt/EBITDA 4.0x including captive finance; cyclical and not forecastable, low free float.

name: Orange SA
reason: French-state-influenced incumbent telco with zero revenue growth over 10y and adjusted EPS down from EUR 1.03 (2015) to 0.86 (2025), ROIC ~2.7% and EBIT margin 8.1% (9th pctile); mature, regulated, no growth route.

name: Porsche Automobil Holding SE
reason: Family-controlled holding whose earnings are its equity share of Volkswagen and Porsche AG, with EPS of EUR -65.36 in 2024 on impairments and 8.65 in 2025; auto-cycle, tariff and EV-transition exposed, and the low P/E reflects a holding discount rather than a special business.

name: Bekaert SA
reason: Steel-wire and tire-cord maker with flat revenue over 10y (CAGR 0.1%) and adjusted EPS swinging EUR 0.70-7.00 on steel and tire cycles, now declining from the 2021 peak to 4.44; commodity-exposed and ordinary.

name: Globant SA
reason: Adjusted EPS compounded 20%/yr (USD 0.98 to 6.14) but growth was acquisition-heavy (acq/FCF 1.42), 2025 EPS fell 4% with consensus FY2-FY3 only ~4% and LTG 1.7%, and GenAI threatens outsourced application development; cannot forecast 5-10 years with confidence.

name: Koninklijke BAM Groep NV
reason: Dutch/UK contractor with a 2020 loss (EPS EUR -1.00), 10y average EBIT margin of 1.2% and current 3.2% margin at its 10y high (100th pctile) with flat revenue; low-margin project business near a peak.

name: ENAV S.p.A.
reason: State-controlled Italian air-navigation monopoly with EU-regulated tariffs; adjusted EPS is EUR 0.17 in 2025 vs 0.19 in 2017 on 2% revenue CAGR, so regulated returns give no proven 7% growth route despite consensus banking on the new tariff period.

name: Adecoagro S.A.
reason: South American crops/sugar/ethanol producer whose EPS swings with commodity prices (USD -0.46 to 1.45, -0.18 in 2025), net debt/EBITDA 13.1x, with Argentine/Brazilian FX risk and new Tether control; fails commodity and balance-sheet tests.

name: Navigator Company SA
reason: Pulp and uncoated-paper producer whose EPS tracks pulp prices (EUR 0.55 in 2022 -> 0.21 in 2025, margin 8.9% vs 21.5% peak) in a secularly declining printing-paper market, controlled by Semapa; commodity earnings.

name: WPP Plc
reason: Advertising holding company with adjusted EPS down from GBP 1.20 (2017) to 0.63 (2025), consensus FY1 -16%, client losses and a credible 5-year AI disintermediation threat to agency fees; cheap but structurally challenged.

name: SeSa S.p.A.
reason: Adjusted EPS compounded 16%/yr (EUR 1.44 to 6.87) with 7/9 years >=7%, but growth relies on a bolt-on roll-up (acq/FCF 0.40) in a 2.8% EBIT-margin IT distribution/integration business with 2024 EPS -12%; durability of growth without acquisitions is unclear.

name: MFE-MediaForEurope NV
reason: Free-to-air TV broadcaster (Italy/Spain) facing secular ad-share loss to streaming, revenue CAGR 1.5% and EPS EUR 0.42 vs 0.96 peak, now levering up for ProSieben (net debt/EBITDA 3.3x) under Berlusconi family control.

name: TotalEnergies SE
reason: Integrated oil major whose EPS is set by oil and gas prices (USD 1.43 in 2020 -> 13.94 in 2022 -> 6.89 in 2025) with consensus FY2-FY3 -11%/-12%; commodity earnings fail the forecastability test.

name: Sopra Steria Group SA
reason: Adjusted EPS grew 10.6%/yr (EUR 6.23 to 17.08) but fell 16% in 2025, margin 8.6% sits at the 91st pctile vs 7.1% average, consensus LTG is 4.3% and GenAI threatens IT-services labour models; decent operator but not forecastable 5-10 years out.

name: International Consolidated Airlines Group SA
reason: Airline group with 2020-21 losses (EPS EUR -1.06), EBIT margin 14.7% at its 10y high (100th pctile) after a recovery, and shares +4.4%/yr from the pandemic raise; fuel, demand and cycle-driven earnings near a peak.

name: CMC Markets Plc
reason: Retail CFD/spread-betting broker whose revenue depends on market volatility and client trading (EPS GBP 0.61 in FY2020 -> 0.15 in FY2022 -> 0.27), with regulatory leverage-cap risk; capital-markets-driven earnings.

name: Telefonica SA
reason: Indebted incumbent telco (net debt/EBITDA 4.8x) with revenue CAGR -2.9%, adjusted EPS down from EUR 0.81 (2018) to 0.33 (2025) and losses in 2023-24, LatAm FX translation drag and a Spanish state (SEPI) shareholder; no growth route.
